article.title: Always the Victim, Never the Bigot: the Zionist campaign against Abdul El-Sayed doubles down
article.author: Donald Johnson
article.content: A Michigan rabbis' 'nonnegotiable' petition demanding El-Sayed disown Hasan Piker reveals a harsh truth for El-Sayed: that no amount of pandering will satisfy critics who want anti-Zionism expelled from the Democratic party outright.
source_folders: 06_左派ニュース・社会主義戦略
